image_description: Three men standing outdoors holding up two large sturgeon fish. The man in the center wears a white long-sleeved shirt with text and graphics, flanked by two other men in darker clothing. Both sturgeons are held vertically, displaying their elongated bodies, scutes, and heterocercal tails.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both fish clearly display the characteristic elongated snout and ventral mouth position typical of sturgeons.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Barbels are visible hanging from the snout area on both fish, though slightly blurry due to image resolution, they are structurally present.
The snouts are distinctly pointed and elongated on both specimens.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bodies are long, cylindrical, and taper towards the tail, matching the fusiform description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of bony plates (scutes) are visible running longitudinally along the sides and back of both fish.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal side is dark gray/brown, transitioning to a lighter white/cream belly, consistent with sturgeon coloration.
The tails of both fish show the characteristic asymmetry where the upper lobe is larger than the lower lobe.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the shirt ('...PORTS') and the graphic below it are distorted and illegible, typical of AI generation struggling with complex typography. The letters merge into the graphic design unnaturally.
The texture of the scutes appears slightly 'painted' or overly smooth in areas, lacking the fine granular detail expected in a high-resolution photo, though acceptable for this image quality.
The fingers gripping the fish, particularly on the right side, appear somewhat fused or indistinct. The anatomy of the hands is plausible but lacks clear definition between fingers and the fish body.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species characteristics and rule out misclassification as other large fish like gar or paddlefish.
To rigorously analyze the gibberish text on the central figure's shirt, a common AI artifact indicator.
To check for fusion artifacts where the hands grip the slippery fish bodies, ensuring distinct boundaries.
To assess overall coherence, lighting consistency, and subtle noise patterns indicative of generation.

focus_areas: Boundary separation between hands and fish
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the shirt; if it is nonsensical, it strongly suggests AI generation despite the realistic appearance of the fish. Also, scrutinize the fingers holding the fish for any melting or fusion with the fish's body.
